meta.title: Implement array length minify optimization
meta.body_summary: Optimize property accesses on array literals during minification and add bundler test for array length folding.

perf_labels.notes: CI build failure across all platforms due to massive accidental deletion in src/js_parser.zig; no human review text or perf evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Despite the high line count, this is an anomalous change: 24,814 lines deleted from src/js_parser.zig (likely a catastrophic rebase or merge error) and only 19 additions. It does not represent a typical incremental perf change; the massive deletion caused immediate build failures and the PR was closed without merge.

review_details.concern_detail: robobun CI reported zig compile errors on all platforms immediately after the commit, blocking any merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Fold array lengths during minification to improve output by reducing property access overhead.
review_details.rejection_signals: CI build failure across all platforms; the massive deletion in js_parser.zig made compilation impossible.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR attempted a minifier optimization but produced a change that deleted most of a critical file, leading to immediate build failure. The agent failed to craft a compilation-correct patch for a complex build system and large Zig codebase.

detection_detail.ci_auto: robobun automated CI detected zig build errors on all platforms and reported them in a PR comment.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance evidence or benchmark provided; the build failure prevented any runtime evaluation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without any follow-up commits after the CI failure; no fix attempted.

core_change_summary.description: Attempted to implement array length folding during minification in src/js_parser.zig and added a test in test/bundler/bundler_minify.test.ts. However, the commit inadvertently removed 24,814 lines from src/js_parser.zig (likely a rebase or merge mishap), causing compile errors.
change_trajectory: Single commit 'feat(minify): fold array length' added 10 lines of test and 9 lines to parser, but also deleted nearly the entire parser file.

review_signals.summary: Reported zig build errors across all platforms for src/js_parser.zig immediately after the commit.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with a single commit that erroneously deleted most of src/js_parser.zig.
robobun immediately posted CI build errors.
No further commits or human reviews; PR closed after ~22 days of inactivity.
